title: "Number Incrementer"
format: html
---

## Add One to Your Number

Enter a number below and click the button to add 1 to it.

<div class="number-app">
  <input type="number" id="numberInput" placeholder="Enter a number" />
  <button id="submitBtn">Add One</button>
  <div id="result" style="margin-top: 20px; font-weight: bold;"></div>
</div>

```{=html}
<style>
.number-app {
  margin: 20px 0;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background-color: #f9f9f9;
}

#numberInput {
  padding: 10px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 4px;
  width: 200px;
}

#submitBtn {
  padding: 10px 20px;
  font-size: 16px;
  background-color: #007bff;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-left: 10px;
}

#submitBtn:hover {
  background-color: #0056b3;
}

#submitBtn:disabled {
  background-color: #ccc;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

#result {
  min-height: 24px;
}

.error {
  color: #dc3545;
}

.success {
  color: #28a745;
}
</style>

<script>
// Replace this with your actual API Gateway endpoint URL
const API_URL = 'https://dj2755ab7h.execute-api.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/prod/add-one';

document.getElementById('submitBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const input = document.getElementById('numberInput');
  const resultDiv = document.getElementById('result');
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  
  const number = input.value;
  
  if (!number) {
    resultDiv.className = 'error';
    resultDiv.textContent = 'Please enter a number';
    return;
  }
  
  // Disable button and show loading
  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  submitBtn.textContent = 'Loading...';
  resultDiv.textContent = '';
  
  try {
    const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ number: parseFloat(number) })
    });
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    if (response.ok) {
      resultDiv.className = 'success';
      resultDiv.textContent = `Result: ${data.input} + 1 = ${data.result}`;
    } else {
      resultDiv.className = 'error';
      resultDiv.textContent = `Error: ${data.error || 'Unknown error'}`;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    resultDiv.className = 'error';
    resultDiv.textContent = `Error: ${error.message}`;
  } finally {
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitBtn.textContent = 'Add One';
  }
});

// Allow pressing Enter to submit
document.getElementById('numberInput').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    document.getElementById('submitBtn').click();
  }
});
</script>
```
